Subject: Initial term sheet + onboarding questions for Azure private offer

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Azure private offer looks like a good fit for our AI inference needs. Attached is a first pass term sheet (Acme_Redwood_TermSheet_v1.pdf) with a couple commercial asks we discussed: a 12-month committed seat baseline with a reserved throughput SKU, and a limited data-retention carve-out for regulated datasets.

Before we proceed to signature we need to clarify three operational items so our procurement and cloud teams can sign off:
- Invoice routing and PO format (our AP team requires PO number and vendor tax id on the invoice)
- Entitlement mapping for Azure private plans (how will SKUs appear in customer's portal and can we map seats to internal cost centers?)
- Co-sell registration process for Azure (who registers and what documentation is needed — we have a vendor co-sell contact in Microsoft)

Can you loop in finance/legal so we can get a clean path to purchase? We’re targeting an internal signing window by Dec 16.

Best,
John Patel
Head of Procurement
Acme Financial
(attachment: Acme_Redwood_TermSheet_v1.pdf)

John — thanks for the term sheet. I reviewed and created a short redline with comments (attachment: redwood_term_sheet_redline.docx). High level: 

- Data retention carve-out: we can accept a 12-month default retention with an addendum for regulated datasets; propose a sentence that limits retention for regulated datasets to the parties' documented retention schedule and references the DPA.
- Liability and indemnity: trimmed to our standard marketplace wording for private offers — suggest mutual cap tied to fees for the first 12 months.
- Azure billing / invoicing: we should include language that clarifies Redwood will invoice via Azure marketplace for private offers but will also provide a separate invoice on request containing PO and vendor tax details to satisfy Acme's AP process.

Please see the redline for specific edits. If that works for Acme’s legal team I can prepare a clean final term sheet for signature and route for DocuSign.

John — quick note from finance on invoice path and PO: 

- Azure private offers are billed through marketplace settlement. Azure issues the invoice to Acme and Azure pays Redwood via marketplace reconciliation. That said, we can produce a Redwood supplemental invoice (PDF) that includes Redwood's vendor tax id, Redwood's remit-to info, and the Acme PO number if Acme shares it with us. We typically deliver the supplemental invoice within 3 business days after Azure settlement for the month the charge occurred.
- To map PO -> entitlement we need: Acme PO number, Cost Center mapping CSV (Marcus will provide template), and a primary AP contact email for routing a copy of the supplemental invoice.

Attached is a short spreadsheet with the fields we need (attachment: invoice-instructions.xlsx). If you can confirm the PO and AP contact we’ll add them to our onboarding checklist and accept scheduling for DocuSign once legal signs off.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
